meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
Haan — **dark spots + dull skin** ke liye India mein meri first choice **10% Vitamin C** hogi, especially agar aap beginner hain. Vitamin C pigmentation/uneven tone ko improve karne mein help karta hai, lekin sunscreen ke bina results limited rahenge. [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/beauty-and-grooming/vitamin-c-serums-that-work-great-for-dark-spots-10929856?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### 🥇 Meri top pick: Minimalist Vitamin C 10%

### [Minimalist Vitamin C 10% Face Serum]()
*₹284*

- **10% Ethyl Ascorbic Acid** — relatively stable Vitamin C form
- Dark spots, dullness aur uneven tone ke liye good starting point
- PHA bhi hai, jo mild exfoliation/brightness mein help kar sakta hai. [beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/collections/dry-skin/products/vitamin-c-ethyl-ascorbic-acid-10-acetyl-glucosamine-1?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Beginner ke liye:** ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

### 🥈 Agar pigmentation + dullness dono target karne hain: Deconstruct 10%

### [Deconstruct 10% Vitamin C Serum]()
*₹458*

Isme **10% liposomal Vitamin C + 0.5% ferulic acid** hai, saath mein soothing ingredients bhi hain. Brand ke according ye pigmentation, dark spots aur dullness ke liye formulated hai. [thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/products/vitamin-c-and-ferulic-acid-serum?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### 🥉 Agar skin already Vitamin C tolerate karti hai

### [Minimalist 16% Vitamin C + E + Ferulic Acid]()
*₹569.10*

16% formula stronger option hai, lekin **pehli baar start kar rahe ho to main 10% se shuru karunga**.

**Use kaise karein:** Morning mein cleanser → 2–3 drops Vitamin C → moisturizer → **SPF 50 sunscreen**. Pehle alternate mornings se start kar sakte hain. Dark spots ko fade hone mein generally several weeks lag sakte hain; daily sunscreen particularly important hai. [www.whowhatwear.com](https://www.whowhatwear.com/beauty/skin/best-products-for-hyperpigmentation?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Agar aap mujhe **apni skin type (oily/dry/combination/sensitive), age aur budget (₹300/₹500/₹1000)** bata do, main aapke liye **exact 1 serum + sunscreen combo** choose kar dunga.

sources.snippet:
This article from Who What Wear UK provides a comprehensive guide to the best skincare products for treating hyperpigmentation, featuring insights from dermatologists and skin experts. Hyperpigmentation, a common skin concern caused by excess melanin, can result from sun exposure, hormonal changes (such as pregnancy-related melasma), inflammation, or acne scarring. The guide emphasizes that the cause of pigmentation determines the best treatment and underlines the importance of daily SPF use as the most critical step in both prevention and treatment.

Recommended ingredients include vitamin C, niacinamide, azelaic acid, tranexamic acid, and retinoids, which can be found in both over-the-counter and prescription products. Experts caution that results typically take 6 to 12 weeks, or even months, and consistency in skincare is essential.

The article highlights 13 carefully selected products, spanning cleansers, serums, moisturizers, and SPFs. Notable mentions include La Roche-Posay Mela B3 Cleanser, Eucerin Pigment Control SPF50+, The Ordinary Azelaic Acid 10%, and Murad Rapid Dark Spot Correcting Serum. Each product is chosen based on expert input, performance, ingredient quality, and user reviews, providing practical options for anyone tackling dark spots and uneven skin tone.
